papers.name: Co-Skill
papers.title: Co-Skill: A Collaborative Communication Framework for Skill Evolution
papers.summary: Merges uploaded trajectory prefixes and progressively expands downloaded skill trees around edge execution failures.

papers.name: EcoAgent
papers.title: EcoAgent: An Efficient Device-Cloud Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Mobile Automation
papers.summary: Combines cloud planning with local observation, verification, concise screen summaries, and closed-loop feedback.

papers.name: Hera

papers.summary: Learns an external step coordinator with imitation learning followed by cost-aware RL over long-horizon outcomes.

papers.exchange_zh: step 状态 / 被选 agent 的动作
papers.evidence: RTX 4090 deployment evaluation; ALFWorld, WebShop, AppWorld; relative cloud-only success is not absolute success.
papers.evidence_zh: RTX 4090 部署评估；ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld；相对 cloud-only 成功率不能当作绝对成功率。

papers.name: GAPG
papers.title: Bridging On-Device and Cloud LLMs for Collaborative Reasoning: A Unified Methodology for Local Routing and Post-Training
papers.summary: Post-trains the local model to reason and internally decide when to invoke cloud assistance using adaptive policy gradients.
papers.summary_zh: 通过自适应策略梯度联合训练端侧推理与内部求助决策。
papers.exchange_zh: 推理 / 求助请求
papers.evidence: Reasoning benchmarks with on-device-scale models; model size alone does not establish real-device feasibility.
papers.evidence_zh: 使用端侧规模模型做推理基准评估；模型大小本身不能证明真实设备可行性。

papers.name: TMO
papers.title: Device-Cloud Collaborative LLM Inference with Multi-Modal, Multi-Task, Multi-Turn Conversations
papers.summary: Jointly selects inference location and modality sources with resource-constrained RL; releases the M4A1 dataset.

papers.exchange_zh: 筛选后的多模态上下文 / 响应
papers.evidence: Offline archived responses, LLM-as-judge quality, and nearest-neighbor estimation of uncertain state-action quality.

papers.name: CIDERS
papers.title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
papers.summary: Couples cloud backbone knowledge transfer and local messenger personalization through bilevel optimization and consensus correction.
papers.summary_zh: 以双层优化和共识校正连接云端 backbone 知识迁移与端侧 messenger 个性化。
papers.exchange_zh: messenger / 共识状态 / backbone 更新

papers.evidence_zh: 未在共同硬件测量完整 runtime、峰值内存和全流量；已计周期载荷约为单 messenger 基线两倍。

papers.name: CDCDA-PLM
papers.title: Towards On-Device Personalization: Cloud-device Collaborative Data Augmentation for Efficient On-device Language Model
papers.summary: Uses cloud-generated personalized augmentation of limited user histories to support on-device PEFT and later local inference.
papers.summary_zh: 云端扩增少量用户历史，生成个性化训练内容，支持端侧 PEFT 与后续本地推理。
papers.exchange_zh: 用户历史 / 合成训练样本
papers.evidence: Personalization benchmarks; local inference does not imply that user data stayed local during augmentation.
papers.evidence_zh: 个性化基准；后续本地推理不代表数据增强阶段用户数据始终留在本地。

papers.name: MobiLLM
papers.title: MobiLLM: Enabling LLM Fine-Tuning on the Mobile Device via Server Assisted Side Tuning
papers.summary: Keeps a frozen backbone on the device and offloads side-network backpropagation through one-way quantized activation transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 端侧保留 frozen backbone，单向传输量化 activation，由云端完成 side-network 反向传播。
papers.exchange_zh: 量化 activation
papers.evidence: Jetson Xavier NX and CPU-only Huawei Matebook with an A100 server over Wi-Fi; these are not smartphone measurements.
papers.evidence_zh: Jetson Xavier NX、纯 CPU 华为 Matebook 与 A100 云端，经 Wi-Fi 协作；不是智能手机实测。

papers.name: FedKRSO
papers.title: FedKRSO: Communication and Memory Efficient Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Shares random subspaces and aggregates low-dimensional update accumulators; uses first-order projected gradients.
papers.summary_zh: 共享随机子空间，聚合低维更新累积量；使用 first-order projected gradient。
papers.exchange_zh: seed / 子空间更新累积量
papers.evidence: GLUE federated experiments; seed-based communication should not be labeled forward-only optimization.
papers.evidence_zh: GLUE 联邦实验；基于 seed 的通信不能归类为 forward-only 优化。

papers.name: pAirZero
papers.title: Three Birds, One Stone: Solving the Communication-Memory-Privacy Trilemma in LLM Fine-tuning Over Wireless Networks with Zeroth-Order Optimization
papers.summary: Combines zeroth-order updates and over-the-air aggregation with joint transmit-power, noise, and privacy-budget design.
papers.summary_zh: 结合零阶更新与 over-the-air 聚合，联合设计发射功率、噪声和隐私预算。
papers.exchange: ZO scalar / sign signals over wireless aggregation
papers.exchange_zh: 无线聚合的 ZO scalar / sign 信号
papers.evidence: A100-based simulation with OPT-125M and five clients on SST-2/SQuAD; no demonstrated phone agent adaptation.
papers.evidence_zh: A100 仿真；OPT-125M、5 个客户端、SST-2/SQuAD；尚未验证手机 agent 适配。

papers.name: FedKSeed
papers.title: Federated Full-Parameter Tuning of Billion-Sized Language Models with Communication Cost under 18 Kilobytes
papers.summary: Enables federated full-parameter tuning with zeroth-order optimization, a finite seed pool, and scalar gradient communication.
papers.summary_zh: 通过零阶优化、有限 seed 池与标量梯度通信，实现联邦全参数微调。
papers.exchange_zh: 有限随机 seed / 标量梯度
papers.evidence: Foundational communication baseline; compact payload alone does not measure total evaluation compute or device energy.
papers.evidence_zh: 低通信量基础基线；紧凑载荷本身不能衡量总评估计算量或端侧能耗。

papers.name: AceSpec
papers.title: AceSpec: An Asymmetric Edge-Cloud Collaborative Framework for Communication-Efficient LLM Inference
papers.summary: Precomputes local recovery branches and uses asymmetric index/sparse-distribution communication for speculative decoding.
papers.summary_zh: 预先构造本地恢复分支，用上行索引与下行稀疏分布优化 speculative decoding 通信。
papers.exchange_zh: draft 索引 / 稀疏验证分布
papers.evidence: Jetson AGX Orin 32GB + 4 x A100 40GB, with tc-shaped WAN; embedded hardware is real, network conditions are emulated.
papers.evidence_zh: Jetson AGX Orin 32GB + 4 x A100 40GB，tc 注入 WAN 条件；硬件真实，网络条件模拟。

papers.name: Speculation at a Distance
papers.title: Speculation at a Distance: Where Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding Actually Pays Off
papers.summary: Analyzes when distributed speculation pays off under RTT constraints and emphasizes multi-tenant cloud capacity.
papers.summary_zh: 分析 RTT 约束下分布式 speculative decoding 的适用区间，强调多租户云端容量。
papers.exchange_zh: draft / 验证协议
papers.evidence: Systems analysis; compare against co-located speculation and separate single-request latency from server throughput.
papers.evidence_zh: 系统分析；应对照共置 speculation，并区分单请求延迟与服务器吞吐。

papers.name: POaaS
papers.title: POaaS: Minimal-Edit Prompt Optimization as a Service to Lift Accuracy and Cut Hallucinations on On-Device sLLMs
papers.summary: Applies conservative minimal-edit prompt cleaning, paraphrasing, and fact addition under drift and length constraints.
papers.summary_zh: 在语义漂移与长度约束下，保守地纠错、改写和补充事实，优化 prompt。
papers.exchange_zh: 改写 prompt
papers.evidence: Same 3B/8B model acts as optimizer and solver; adjacent on-device work, not a validated strong-cloud collaboration method.
papers.evidence_zh: 同一 3B/8B 模型担任 optimizer 与 solver；属于端侧邻近工作，未验证强云端协同。

papers.name: HintKD
papers.title: HintKD: Hint Knowledge Distillation for Bandwidth-Constrained Cloud-Edge Inference
papers.summary: Encodes teacher guidance as a codebook index interpreted by a student FiLM adapter.
papers.summary_zh: 将 teacher 指导编码为 codebook 索引，由 student 的 FiLM adapter 解释。
papers.exchange_zh: 离散 hint 索引
papers.evidence: DeepSense 6G beam prediction and MNIST; transferring the idea to LLMs or agents remains a research hypothesis.
papers.evidence_zh: DeepSense 6G 波束预测、MNIST；迁移至 LLM/agent 仍是研究假设。

papers.name: OpenPhone
papers.title: OpenPhone: Mobile Agentic Foundation Models
papers.summary: Runs a 3B GUI agent tuned with SFT then GRPO on the device by default and hands the task to a cloud MLLM once periodic monitoring detects repeated actions, trajectory deviation, or inadequate action quality.
papers.summary_zh: 默认由经 SFT 再 GRPO 调优的 3B 端侧 GUI agent 执行；定期监控发现重复动作、偏离预期轨迹或动作质量不足时，把任务切换给云端 MLLM。
papers.exchange: GUI state and execution history / cloud agent actions after the switch
papers.exchange_zh: GUI 状态与执行历史 / 切换后云端 agent 的动作
papers.evidence: AndroidLab online evaluation plus 25 custom tasks on four apps; model latency is measured with vLLM on one or two RTX 3090 GPUs, not on phones; in the collaboration analysis the cloud still performs about 65% of steps.
papers.evidence_zh: AndroidLab 在线评测，另加四个 app 的 25 个自建任务；模型延迟用 vLLM 在一张或两张 RTX 3090 上测量，不是手机实测；协同分析中云端仍执行约 65% 的步骤。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: DySCo
papers.title: DySCo: Dynamic Sharding for Collaborative Edge-Cloud LLM Inference with Depth-Synchronized Batching
papers.summary: Splits one LLM at a per-session layer boundary, keeps KV caches with their shards, and batches sessions that enter the cloud at different depths by advancing them to the deepest cut and sharing the common suffix.
papers.summary_zh: 按会话在某一层把同一个 LLM 切成端侧前缀和云端后缀，KV cache 留在各自的 shard 上；不同切分深度的会话先推进到最深的切点，再对共同的后缀层做批处理。
papers.exchange_zh: 切分层的 hidden state / 下一个 token ID
papers.evidence: Single-edge runs pair a Jetson Orin (8 GB, over WAN) or datacenter GPUs with an RTX A6000 cloud; the multi-edge batching study runs all edge and cloud processes on one multi-GPU server, so it isolates scheduling from wide-area network variation.
papers.evidence_zh: 单端实验用 Jetson Orin（8 GB，经 WAN）或数据中心 GPU 搭配 RTX A6000 云端；多端批处理实验的端侧和云端进程都跑在同一台多 GPU 服务器上，只隔离出调度行为，不含广域网波动。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: EdgeWise
papers.title: EdgeWise: Bringing Long-Horizon Agents to the Edge via Selective Cloud Delegation
papers.summary: A local SLM is the primary solver for long-horizon coding-agent tasks and hands selected steps to a cloud LLM; delegation is decided either by an external judge or by the SLM itself after SFT plus step-level RL that assigns credit to individual delegation decisions.
papers.summary_zh: 端侧 SLM 作为长程 coding agent 任务的主求解者，只把选中的步骤交给云端 LLM；是否委托由外部 judge 决定，或由经过 SFT 和 step-level RL（对每个委托决策单独分配 credit）训练的 SLM 自己决定。
papers.exchange: Trajectory history (full or trimmed) for a delegated step / the cloud LLM's analysis and action for that step
papers.exchange_zh: 被委托步骤所需的轨迹历史（完整或裁剪）/ 云端 LLM 为该步生成的分析与动作
papers.evidence: Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-ReBench with Qwen3.5-9B as the SLM and API-served frontier models as the cloud LLM; the main runs serve the SLM on A100 GPUs, and a separate deployment runs the self-delegation model on one NVIDIA DGX Spark calling a cloud API; reported cost is API cost, not device energy.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 SWE-ReBench 上评测，SLM 为 Qwen3.5-9B，云端 LLM 为 API 调用的前沿模型；主实验的 SLM 跑在 A100 上，另有一组部署实验把自委托模型放在单台 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上调用云端 API；报告的成本是 API 费用，不含设备能耗。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages

papers.name: EC2-Bench
papers.title: Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution
papers.summary: Builds EC2-Bench, 128 executable digital-workspace agent tasks scored on task completion, cloud cost and edge FLOPs, and the share of annotated sensitive items visible to the cloud, and uses it to compare query routing, per-step routing, edge-controlled delegation, and edge-controlled advisory.
papers.summary_zh: 构建 EC2-Bench：128 个可执行的数字工作区 agent 任务，从任务完成度、云端费用与端侧 FLOPs、标注的敏感信息被云端看到的比例三方面打分，并用它比较 query 路由、逐步路由、端侧主导的委托和端侧主导的咨询四种协同方式。
papers.exchange: Task instruction and execution history visible to the cloud / cloud-generated actions (delegation) or plans and suggestions (advisory)
papers.exchange_zh: 云端可见的任务指令与执行历史 / 云端生成的动作（委托）或计划与建议（咨询）
papers.evidence: All configurations run in the OpenClaw runtime with Qwen3.5-2B/9B as current edge models, Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.7-Plus as proxies for stronger future edge models, and GLM-5.3 as the main cloud model; edge cost is estimated in FLOPs rather than measured on devices, and privacy exposure is judged by an LLM checked against 200 human labels.
papers.evidence_zh: 全部配置在 OpenClaw 运行时中执行，端侧用 Qwen3.5-2B/9B 代表当前模型、Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.7-Plus 作为未来更强端侧模型的代理，云端主要用 GLM-5.3；端侧开销以 FLOPs 估算而非设备实测，隐私暴露由 LLM 判定，并用 200 条人工标注做了核对。
papers.code_status: author-linked

papers.name: Local-First Intelligence
papers.title: Local-First Intelligence via Proactive SLM Collaborating with Feedback-Providing LLM
papers.summary: Trains an on-device SLM with RL to decide when and how to consult a cloud LLM over several turns, while the prompted LLM either answers or asks for clarification; the reward combines answer quality, interaction necessity, clarification feedback, and a privacy-leak penalty, with training data from a synthesized privacy-augmented QA set (PrivQA).
papers.summary_zh: 用 RL 训练端侧 SLM 在多轮中决定何时、以何种请求向云端 LLM 求助，云端 LLM 只经提示、可以回答或要求澄清；奖励综合答案质量、交互必要性、澄清反馈与隐私泄露惩罚，训练数据来自合成的隐私增强 QA 数据集 PrivQA。
papers.exchange: SLM-formulated information requests meant to omit private user details / LLM answers or clarification requests
papers.exchange_zh: SLM 构造的、力求不含用户隐私的信息请求 / LLM 的回答或澄清请求
papers.evidence: PrivQA built from six QA datasets plus zero-shot PUPA, AESLC, and SAMSum; SLMs are Qwen3-4B/8B and Llama 3B/8B, cloud LLMs include DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, Qwen3-235B-A22B, and Qwen3-Max; training uses 8×H20 GPUs, and latency is measured with Qwen3-8B on one RTX 4090 against a cloud API, not on a phone.
papers.evidence_zh: PrivQA 由六个 QA 数据集构造，另在 PUPA、AESLC、SAMSum 上零样本评测；SLM 为 Qwen3-4B/8B 和 Llama 3B/8B，云端 LLM 包括 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B、Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 Qwen3-Max；训练用 8 张 H20，延迟用单张 RTX 4090 上的 Qwen3-8B 对接云端 API 测得，不是手机实测。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages

papers.name: SLM Interpreter
papers.title: Should SLMs be in the Driver's Seat? A Study of Local Models as Interpreters in Cloud-Written Agent Programs
papers.summary: The cloud LLM writes a Python program for the user's task that runs on the device, and the program calls a local SLM through an ordinary function only for bounded questions over user data; on failure the stack trace goes back to the LLM for a rewrite, up to five attempts.
papers.summary_zh: 云端 LLM 为用户任务写一段在设备上运行的 Python 程序，程序只在需要解读用户数据的有界问题上通过普通函数调用本地 SLM；执行出错时把 stack trace 发回 LLM 重写，最多尝试五次。
papers.exchange: User request and, on failure, stack traces that can contain user content / the generated program
papers.exchange_zh: 用户请求，以及失败时可能含有用户内容的 stack trace / 生成的程序
papers.evidence: AppWorld Test Normal and Test Challenge with Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and Qwen3-Coder-Next as planners and Qwen3.5 SLMs up to 9B; all models are served with llama.cpp on A100 or V100 GPUs, so device cost is reported as token and context counts rather than latency or energy.
papers.evidence_zh: 在 AppWorld 的 Test Normal 和 Test Challenge 上评测，规划模型为 Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 和 Qwen3-Coder-Next，SLM 为不超过 9B 的 Qwen3.5；所有模型都用 llama.cpp 跑在 A100 或 V100 上，端侧开销以 token 与上下文长度报告，没有延迟或能耗实测。
papers.code_status: not located in checked paper pages
